message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional baked lasagna: | Category | Typical Items | |----------|---------------| | **Pasta** | • 9–12 sheets of lasagna noodles (no-boil or regular) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork)
• 1 onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
• 1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce
• 1 cup beef broth or water
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Cheese Layer** | • 2 cups shredded mozzarella
• 1 cup grated Parmesan
• 1 cup ricotta cheese (optional but adds creaminess) | | **Egg & Herb Mix** | • 1 egg (beat lightly; optional, helps bind ricotta)
• 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley or basil (optional) | | **Seasoning** | • 1 tsp sugar (balances acidity)
• Pinch red‑pepper flakes (optional for heat) | | **Optional Add‑ins** | • Sautéed spinach or mushrooms
• Sliced zucchini or eggplant
• Fresh herbs (basil, oregano) | **Basic Assembly Steps** 1. **Cook the meat sauce**: Brown the meat with onions and garlic, then add tomatoes, broth, herbs, salt, pepper, and simmer for ~30 min. 2. **Prepare the cheese mixture**: Combine ricotta, beaten egg, half the Parmesan, and herbs. 3. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a baking dish. Place a sheet of noodles, spread ricotta mixture, sprinkle mozzarella, repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and a generous topping of mozzarella + Parmesan. 4. **Bake**: Cover with foil (tent it so it doesn’t touch the cheese) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden. 5. **Rest**: Let stand 10 min before slicing. Feel free to tweak quantities or add veggies based on your preference!
